news.text: #SUZUKI IS TOO IM(GOAL)TANT#DiGregorio in meltdown: #Juve absolutely needs the Japanese or another one up to the task.What mistakes against #Inter: #Dimarco and #Diouf seal the 2-1.#Spalletti cannot go on with this anxiety between the posts: after chasing #Alisson and #Martínez, he is now waiting for #PSG to buy #Parma's number 1 and then receive him on loan. But #LuisEnrique might keep him for a while to evaluate him and time is running out: #Vicario remains the backup. In Perth, #Conceição pulls one back and #Alajbegovic comes close to the equalizer (brillant alongside #Kolo). Lucio: "They are more of a team. And yes, #Digre could have done better...". #Chivu: "I expect more".[Front Page T

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "#KoloMuani and #Alajbegovic? I evaluate them highly, in the sense that, before signing them, I watched them carefully and I know them well. #Alajbegovic was already getting followed previously by #Massara, so these are things that give us peace of mind. However, they need to reach full fitness, because they arrived just three days ago and maybe it was a bit forced to ask them to play an entire half. They are strong players who possess an important level of football, but then we have to see how we will manage to find the right balance, how we will manage to become a team. 🟣 Confirmation on what was already reported a month and a half ago by @Glongari and @AlfredoPedulla: #Fiorentina, in the next few days, will try to close the negotiation with #Parma for #Pellegrino, the forward chosen to take #Piccoli's place in attack. This is the relay @tvdellosport[Luca Cilli]

🔚 #Juventus, situation regarding outbound players:🇮🇹 Something is moving for #DiGregorio, the main candidate to vacate his spot among the goalkeepers. #Marseille and #Valencia have called in recent hours, but the Premier League remains the most likely destination;🇨🇴 There is insistence, within the framework of the negotiation for #Lucumí, on the inclusion of #Cabal. #Bologna has not closed the door, but does not want to negotiate based on high figures. There is also some interest from Spain;🇮🇹 #Monza and #Sassuolo are on the tracks of #Rugani on loan. The newly promoted club is currently in pole position;🇳🇱 #Koopmeiners is out of the project. There is a certain buzz in England, but also some

🇯🇵 "#PSG is on the verge of signing Zion #Suzuki for around €35M (including bonuses) and would be willing to loan him to #Juventus on a simple loan (without an option to buy).The #Juve management remains in constant contacts with the goalkeeper's agents and must now decide whether to move forward under these conditions."[@MatteMoretto and @FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

❌️ "The recent rumors linking Manuel #Locatelli with #RealMadrid are completely false.The player renewed his contract with #Juventus a few months ago and his desire is to stay to be a key protagonist in Luciano #Spalletti's setup, something he has already communicated directly to the coach."[@MatteMoretto and @FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🇨🇮🧐 "#Kessié is always to be kept in mind: contacts are daily and he has Saudi Arabia on standby just to wait for #Juventus. An economic baseline agreement is still needed, likely with efforts from both sides. He is still an option, also because #Thuram is injured and #Spalletti is looking for a midfielder. #Frattesi had also emerged, but keep an eye on the Ivorian: he has always shown great openness and is ready to make sacrifices on his salary. It remains to be seen if they will truly want to make a decisive push."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧱❗️The priority in defense is still #Lucumí, with the pressure on #Bologna continuing thanks also to the Colombian's desire, who has put other proposals on standby. The agreement with #Bologna still needs to be found: they are asking for at least €25M, while #Juventus would prefer not to exceed the €20M. The option of including #Cabal is gaining more and more traction. To finance the investment, an exit might be necessary: eyes on #Gatti.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🧐 #Juventus considers #Suzuki the best possible alternative for the goal, with the idea of waiting for #PSG's decisive move and then taking him on a simple loan: Campos would have proposed this during the discussions for #KoloMuani. #Carnevali is willing to look into it, but the loan must not include any costs except for the salary. Others are less convincing: a slowdown on #Atubolu, for #Trubin things did not go beyond exploratory inquiries and #Vicario does not fully convince.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]
